changes: Photographs cropped and reprojected into the original Helsinki wall UV triangles; lamps, pots, tram wires, trees, fountain and fence excluded using clear same-building masonry/window donors. Front portico and crest retained. Three rectangular recessed side bays plus separate projecting corner bays and five arched rear bays retain different architecture. Hidden side detail and rear basement reconstructed from analogous clean same-building bays. No geometric/collision/source-master changes; no Google pixels.
